name: Pedal bin
definition: kitchen bin whose lid is opened by a foot pedal.
notes: John Lewis Pedal Bins category (35); Dunelm Pedal Bins filter (88)

name: Sensor bin
definition: kitchen bin whose lid opens automatically when a sensor detects a hand or movement.

name: Recycling bin
definition: kitchen bin with two or more sections for sorting waste and recyclables.
notes: John Lewis Recycling Bins category (34); Dunelm Recycling Bins filter (44)

name: Heated airer
definition: electrically heated indoor rack on which washing is hung to dry.

name: Rotary airer (rotary washing line)
definition: umbrella-style outdoor washing line on a central pole with arms that turn.
notes: Dunelm Rotary Washing Lines category (21); Homebase Rotary Airer (11)
